'''Specialist Unit Two Hundred Seven''' was a [[Brigade/Legends|brigade]] of [[Shock trooper/Legends|shock troopers]] commanded by [[Kr'saang]] the [[Togorian/Legends|Togorian]]. Operating from the ''[[Dar'oosh]]'', the unit was absorbed into the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]]'s [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Army/Legends|army]] following the [[Death/Legends|death]] of their leader on [[Darkknell/Legends|Darkknell]] in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]].
